description.narrative: At the beginning of the drought crisis in late 2016, individual agencies attempted to seek for START funds in order to respond to the drought. Discussions by INGOs in the START network, revealed that the scale of the crisis was much bigger that what the START funds could handle. The INGOs working in the ASAL areas thereafter came together in a meeting on 4thJanuary 2017 to form a joint humanitarian response effort to collect data and information with a view to developing joint interventions. This was followed by Country Directors’ meeting which approved the same. Consequently a technical team meeting in which 10 INGOs were represented drafted a format for data collection. With support from the draw down funds, information analysis and prioritization of needs and geographical location will be carried between these second half of January. The draw down request will be used to support collaborative data and information collection and analysis, scenario building and development of a joint response plan as well as collection and publication of media stories.
